item.title: Scenes at Portswood not welcome - Letter
item.description: Contemporaries of Nigel Farage have claimed that he exhibited racist behaviour in his youth. Now, as an adult, he has unleashed a toxic and unpleasant aspect of British culture.

item.title: Fear police community meetings will stop while protests continue
item.description: Concerns have been raised that police community meetings will no longer take place in Portswood while protests continue over the use of a hotel as accommodation for asylum seekers.

item.title: Investigation as 'passenger punches taxi driver after refusing to pay fare'
